name: ironclad-a10-10seed-v1.1
description: Fixed 10-seed Ironclad A10 standard-mode evaluation set on game v0.111.0 (v1.1 = v1's seeds and limits, re-pinned from v0.107.1; never rank v1 and v1.1 results together). Same 10 seed strings as ironclad-a0-10seed (seed-by-seed A0 vs A10 comparison). Baseline v2-a10 (v2 with preferred ascension 10, so the lobby starts at A10 on the legacy menu path too); the runner verifies ascension 10 from the MCP readback, game.log and current_run.save for every seed.
